title: cid: maintain sha256 on FileNode/copy, Direct HTTP Write and extraction
description: draft-atwood-jmap-cid-00.md:222-224 require updating sha256 only on FileNode/set create/update. In filenode-20 content also changes via FileNode/copy (new blob, may differ), Direct HTTP Write PUT/PATCH, and archive extraction (Blob/convert). Cover all of them; bump the filenode ref at :34 to -20. crate-jmap already recomputes sha256 on copy (crate-jmap-filenode-server filenode.rs:1741-1776); make the spec match.
